name: pi-multi-agent
description: Multi-harness subagents, workflows, and shared coordination infrastructure for Pi

scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test:companion && npm run test:subagents:portable && npm run test:workflows
scripts.test:shared: node --test --experimental-strip-types extensions/shared/json-schema.test.ts extensions/shared/child-session.test.ts extensions/shared/context-utilization.test.ts extensions/shared/tool-call-timeout.test.ts extensions/shared/observability.test.ts extensions/shared/observability-d2.test.ts extensions/shared/service-registry.test.ts extensions/shared/redaction.test.ts extensions/shared/companion-home.test.ts
scripts.test:subagents:portable: node --test --experimental-strip-types extensions/subagents/manager.test.ts extensions/subagents/index-lifecycle.test.ts extensions/subagents/role-lock.test.ts extensions/subagents/roles.test.ts extensions/subagents/result-delivery.test.ts extensions/subagents/context-usage.test.ts extensions/subagents/takeover.test.ts extensions/subagents/by-the-way.test.ts extensions/subagents/structured-output.test.ts extensions/subagents/backend-structured.test.ts extensions/subagents/pi-backend-structured.test.ts extensions/subagents/codex-hermetic.test.ts extensions/subagents/prompt.test.ts extensions/subagents/producer-sink.test.ts extensions/subagents/parent-hooks.test.ts extensions/subagents/protected-paths.test.ts extensions/subagents/daemon-control.test.ts
scripts.test:workflows: node --test --experimental-strip-types extensions/workflows/sandbox.test.ts extensions/workflows/controller.test.ts extensions/workflows/meta.test.ts extensions/workflows/serialization.test.ts extensions/workflows/agent-bridge.test.ts extensions/workflows/artifacts.test.ts extensions/workflows/dashboard.test.ts extensions/workflows/extension-integration.test.ts extensions/workflows/observability.test.ts extensions/workflows/no-legacy-runner.test.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write companion extensions docs MULTI_AGENT_HANDOVER.md README.md BUGS.md AGENTS.md tsconfig.companion.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check companion extensions docs MULTI_AGENT_HANDOVER.md README.md BUGS.md AGENTS.md tsconfig.companion.json
